# THE COMPOSITION MATRIX (2026-08-26, the spread application rework):
# unequal cross-statement spreads on one bag apply INDEPENDENTLY per
# child -- children meet each template's constraints and never meet
# each other's data. The historic crosswire (use-cases/BUGS.md sec 6-7)
# rode a stateful ExpectVal baked into the combined template and shared
# across destinations; ExpectVal.unify is now pure. Every row below is
# parity-probed (both CLIs agree). Matrix: unequal-spread x {literal,
# ref-arriving, key()-bearing} templates x {2,3 children} x {map,list},
# plus requiredness/defaults through the combine, generator-over-
# spread-augmented data, and id-merge x unequal ref spreads.
# map x literal x 2 children: the minimal sec-7 crosswire shape --
# each child keeps ITS OWN p and r (5/6 never meet).
spread-unequal-map-2
# map x literal x 3 children: a third sibling meets the same combined
# constraint, still no cross-talk.
spread-unequal-map-3
# map x key()-bearing x 2: key() in one unequal template resolves per
# child (the combined template stays path-dependent, so it is a fresh
# instance per destination).
spread-unequal-map-key-2
# map x key()-bearing x 3.
spread-unequal-map-key-3
# map x ref-arriving x 2 (BUGS.md sec 6, the oneview shape): unequal
# templates meeting BY REFERENCE through a conjunction of hidden
# schemas -- per-child default d, per-child n.
spread-unequal-map-ref-2
# map x ref-arriving x 3.
spread-unequal-map-ref-3
# id-merge x unequal ref spreads (BUGS.md sec 6, the idmerge shape):
# two views of one id()-merged entity under different ref-arriving
# templates -- the entity's sibling ports stay independent and both
# positions emit the merged entity.
spread-unequal-idmerge
# requiredness survives the combine: a key contributed by the OTHER
# template is still required at every child (fresh per-destination
# expectation, not the template's own node).
spread-unequal-required
# defaults through the combine: one template's *1|integer defaults
# per child and stays overridable per child.
spread-unequal-pref
# list x literal x 2 elements: the same independence on list bags
# (elements meet the combined constraint, never each other).
spread-unequal-list-2
# list x literal x 3 elements.
spread-unequal-list-3
# list x key()-bearing: key() at a list element is the INDEX (the
# documented rule), resolved per element through the combine.
spread-unequal-list-key
# list x ref-arriving templates.
spread-unequal-list-ref
